$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: An offer sent before the exact v1 hello is out of order

rejection.rule: The exact closed v1 hello MUST precede protocol_v2_offer, and the offer MUST precede observations and acceptance. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1)
rejection.effect: No v2 acceptance switches wire mode. The desktop emits protocol_error_v2 unexpected_message for the out-of-order offer; both sides remain in v1 mode.

summary: The phone sends protocol_v2_offer as the first text message, before the v1 hello. The order violates §4.1; acceptance must not follow.

steps.note: Hello arrives after the offer. The required order is hello -> offer -> observations. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1)

outcome: Wire mode remains v1. The phone MUST NOT switch to v2 output without a valid acceptance, and a valid acceptance requires hello before offer on this connection.
